name: Environment
why: A thread's machine, from its cloud environment to a local session when the work needs the Mac
ideal: A cloud thread knows its GitHub route and limits, pushes in seconds, and hands local work to a Mac session that closes when done.

steps.name: Say
steps.rule: A thread reads its GitHub route, where network and variables live, and when work goes to a local session.

steps.name: Push
steps.rule: A push reaches GitHub in seconds, so the environment's network allows what the thread needs.

steps.name: Hand off
steps.rule: Work that needs a local tool runs in a local session, which is archived when its task ends.

steps.name: Ask less
steps.rule: A session runs without stopping for approval, since each stop is a wait.

steps.name: Spend
steps.rule: The fullest weekly plan window stays under its goal, so new work is never blocked.
